# Corpay Expands Its AI Agent Team to Give Businesses More Control Over Spend


Press Releases


September 24, 2026


11:31 AM


## Share


Press Releases


September 24, 2026


11:31 AM


One Card. One Platform. AI Agents Built to Work for Your Team.​


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 24, 2026-- Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), the Global Spend Management Company, today announced it is expanding its team of purpose-built AI agents inside[Corpay Complete](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.corpay.com%2Fcorpay-complete&esheet=54610364&newsitemid=20260924972539&lan=en-US&anchor=Corpay+Complete&index=1&md5=4a2e597f7b959b79505be136a007b9d4) . Each agent is built to do one job well across corporate, fleet, and vendor payments.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260924972539/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260924972539/en/)


Corpay’s expanded AI agent team helps businesses gain greater visibility and control over spend.


Corpay's AI capabilities are accelerating fast. In April this year, it introduced its first agent, the AI Virtual Assistant Agent, which gives users visibility into spend, and answers their questions. In July, Agent Card gave trusted AI agents a secure way to create and use virtual cards within existing payment controls. Today, Corpay is growing that team.


Together, Corpay's agents understand spend, do the work, and help businesses act. They all run inside Corpay Complete, which brings spend data, workflows, and payments together in one place. Every agent operates with the finance-grade controls and full audit visibility that finance teams already trust.


"We didn't set out to build one AI agent that claims to do everything well," said Danny Martucci, President & GM of Commercial Card at Corpay. "Businesses are looking for agents they can trust to do the work accurately and securely. There's no new system to learn. It's a team of agents that works the way you already do, with added efficiency to help your business save more time and money."​


**Corpay's New AI Agents:**


- **Embedded Insights Agent** helps admins to analyze spend and automatically flags anomalies, with no report required.
- **AI Voice Assistant Agent** creates and completes expenses by voice in addition to answering questions about cards, transactions, and account status in plain language.
- **Accounting Coding Agent** automatically codes transactions for card administrators to the correct GL account, tax code, and cost center.


Corpay's expanding roster of AI agents is rolling out to eligible Corpay Complete customers this month, with more agents on the way. Learn more at[www.corpay.com/commercial-cards/corpay-mastercard/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.corpay.com%2Fcommercial-cards%2Fcorpay-mastercard%2F&esheet=54610364&newsitemid=20260924972539&lan=en-US&anchor=www.corpay.com%2Fcommercial-cards%2Fcorpay-mastercard%2F&index=2&md5=5e89156ff51d6aeffc90872fd4fd2079) .​


​ **About Corpay** ​


Corpay (NYSE: CPAY), the Global Spend Management Company, is an S&P 500 company with three primary B2B solution sets: Spend Management, provides corporate and virtual card programs and automates procure-to-pay; Cross-Border, converts foreign currencies and establishes foreign bank accounts; Vehicle Solutions, controls fuel, tolls, parking and related vehicle spend. With Corpay, the more a business controls, the less it spends. ​Learn more at[www.corpay.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.corpay.com&esheet=54610364&newsitemid=20260924972539&lan=en-US&anchor=www.corpay.com&index=3&md5=894c88dc05e8f73d4a6021e125a2708e) .
